# Feature: Live Browser Capability & Tools

## 1. Feature Goal

**ID**: FEAT-025
**Source Plan**: `.spec-lite/plan_agentic.md`

Make interactive browsing real. This feature closes the repo's oldest gap — no production code constructs the live `InjectedScriptHost` the locator engine requires — and exposes the browser to the agent as five tools (`browser_navigate`, `browser_observe`, `browser_click`, `browser_fill`, `browser_extract`) over a run-scoped controller with a fresh ephemeral profile, popup interception, generation-scoped opaque element refs, and `SecretRef` host-binding enforcement on fills. Against a local fixture site, a real agent navigates, observes, fills, clicks, extracts, and verifies a result in real Chrome — and no CSS/XPath or resolved secret ever enters the model or session log.

## 2. Data Model (Granular)

In-memory run-scoped state plus one protocol extension.

### Entities & Attributes

- **BrowserController** (run-scoped, `packages/core/src/browser/agent-controller.ts`):
  - `runId` (string), `page` (single Puppeteer page — the run page), `profileDir` (string, fresh ephemeral temp profile, deleted at teardown), `launched` (boolean, lazy).
  - Popup policy state: intercepted popups are closed; captured `targetUrl` returned in the triggering tool's result (plan §5 single-page and popup policy).
- **ObservationGeneration**:
  - `generation` (number, monotonic per run page), `refs` (Map<string, InteractableRecord>), invalidated by navigation, reload, DOM-changing actions, popups, and each new observation.
- **InteractableRecord**: `ref` (opaque, e.g. `"e7"`), `role` (string), `name` (string), `boundingBox`, internal locator handle (never model-visible). Model sees only `{ref, role, name}` + sanitized digest.
- **SecretRef host binding** (protocol extension):
  - Secret declaration gains `hosts` (string[], required for website secrets used by agentic fills) — exact-host or registrable-domain match rule, documented. Stored with secret **metadata** (keychain entry metadata / config), never with the value.
- **Observation result** (model-visible, bounded): `url`, `title`, sanitized readable digest (byte-capped), ranked interactables list (count-capped).

### Relationships

- 1 run : 1 BrowserController : 1 page : N observation generations; refs are scoped `(run, page, generation)` — plan §5.
- `browser_fill` with `SecretRef` → resolver → host-binding check against live page host → injected fill; the resolved value exists only inside the executing tool (plan §4).

### Indexes & Constraints

- Stale/unknown ref → `STALE_ELEMENT_REF` structured error directing re-observation.
- The model never supplies CSS/XPath/DOM ids/JS (locked, plan §5); tools accept opaque refs only.
- CDP pipe transport (`--remote-debugging-pipe`), system Chrome (memory).

## 6. Cross-Cutting Concerns

- **Auth**: website secrets only — resolved inside `browser_fill` under host binding + confirmation; never in model/session/audit. Model credentials untouched here.
- **Error Handling**: actionability failures (`STALE_ELEMENT_REF`, occlusion, disabled) are *expected* structured results guiding the agent; ethics blocks are typed refusals with handoff info; all via the FEAT-024 middleware chokepoint.
- **Logging**: `debug` for locator candidate decisions (existing convention), `info` for navigation; full URLs recorded in audit (plan §8.13); never page content in logs.
- **Security**: this feature carries plan §8.3 (opaque refs), §8.5 (secret isolation), §8.6 (ethics), §8.12 (host binding), §8.14 (ephemeral profile), and the popup policy; secret-canary scans over every artifact are acceptance criteria.
